initial.title: Spider with a Paint Palette
initial.composition: One spider balances a small palette beside its body and holds a short brush with one front leg, seven other legs easy to count.
initial.prompt: Create ONE original polished storybook illustrated clipart, not a photo or3D render. One spider balances a small palette beside its body and holds a short brush with one front leg, seven other legs easy to count. Warm playful character for personal art activity cards. Two spider body segments, expressive eyes and small smile. EXACTLY EIGHT long jointed LEGS arranged in FOUR PAIRS. LEFT four clearly separated legs from front body segment at10,9,8,7 oclock; RIGHT four at2,3,4,5. Choose high overhead three-quarter viewpoint so all eight legs are traceable from separate roots to tips. Front legs can touch props, but they count within the eight; no extra human arms, hands, antennae or pedipalps. Thoughtfully designed confident dark outlines, warm smooth color shapes and restrained cel shading with a few broad fur tufts, NOT thousands of fine hairs, grain or photographic texture. Complete original scene centered in middle65% square with generous empty transparent margins. True transparent background and gaps; no glow, haze, surrounding shadow, white fringe, logo, readable text or numbers.
